name: Loll Player
summary:
Loll Player is a mixed-reality player for the library you already keep: family videos, photos, movies, and 180°/360° files shot over the years in many formats.

Watch in a quiet space. Recenter the screen to your gaze so you can lie down, recline, sit, or stand. The picture stays still — you don't walk around.

Open files from on-headset storage, USB, SMB, WebDAV, SFTP, FTP, UPnP, Jellyfin, or a media-library URL you type. Local playback does not need the internet. Quest 3 plays 8K60 HEVC. Flat, 180°, and 3
